He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death. He makes ready his flaming arrows.
Contend, Yahweh, with those who contend with me. Fight against those who fight against me.

translations.web: You uncovered your bow. You called for your sworn arrows. You split the earth with rivers.
translations.bsb: You brandished Your bow; You called for many arrows. Selah You split the earth with rivers.
translations.kjv: Thy bow was made quite naked, according to the oaths of the tribes, even thy word. Selah. Thou didst cleave the earth with rivers.
translations.asv: Thy bow was made quite bare; The oaths to the tribes were a sure word. Selah. Thou didst cleave the earth with rivers.
